name: crossref-mcp-server
description: Resolve DOIs, search ~155M scholarly works, and fetch references via the Crossref REST API. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Resolve DOIs, search ~155M scholarly works, fetch references, and look up publishers via the Crossref REST API.
interface.longDescription: MCP server wrapping the Crossref REST API. Exposes tools to resolve DOIs to full metadata records, search ~155M registered works, retrieve outgoing references, search journals by ISSN or title, search funders, resolve a member ID to its publisher record (prefixes, DOI counts, metadata deposit coverage), and resolve a DOI prefix to its owning publisher. Supports STDIO and Streamable HTTP transports.
